name: 当前云台 Pitch · DM3507_FAST_OBSERVER_V2F
telemetryRule: Only a complete known-group FireWater line whose comma-separated fields are all numeric is telemetry; retain other text.

rules.note: QUERY|TIMEOUT is a board-side failed query, not a successful check.
The same line is also emitted spontaneously on guard changes.
The same line can be an asynchronous serial or remote step result; STATE may be IDLE/RUNNING/DONE/ABORTED.
ACK has no step ID; do not claim strict request identity or finish on RUNNING.
ACK means target accepted, not that the axis has reached home.
Changes firmware telemetry group; never send automatically.

association: No request ID exists in current firmware; only one command waits at once. Unknown, unrelated and uncertain messages remain visible. Telemetry and active events do not reset a report's timeout or terminate it.
purpose: Protocol reference and default UI preset. Actual runtime rule loading is documented by the implementation; this JSON alone is not proof that every listed command is recognized.
